column2: [intro]
One morning, I woke up bright,
With mismatched socks, what a sight!
I thought, what a crazy plan,
To wander the world without a map in hand.
I've got news to share with you,
A funny story, fresh and new.
Buckle up, it's going to be wild,
Get ready to laugh till we’re all beguiled!
I took a flight, off I went,
But forgot my pants, oh what a bent!
Found myself all dressed in the nude,
Singing to a crowd, quite amused.
I’ve got news to share with you,
A funny story, fresh and new.
Buckle up, it's going to be wild,
Get ready to laugh till we’re all beguiled!
